'''Gregory<!-- the Opportunist-->''' is an [[NPC]] that appears in the {{zone|Dragon's Nest}} while a [[Ender Dragon|Dragon]] fight is taking place, as well as the {{Zone|Jerry Pond}} when a {{MobSprite|Reindrake}} is caught. Upon these creatures' death, Gregory will leave.

{{/UI}}

== Trivia ==
* Gregory's title, "The Opportunist" and his dialogue suggests that the reason he appears during enemy fights is to capitalize on the players' lack of a bow and arrows by selling them for an inflated price.
*The [[Flint Arrow]]s sold by '''Gregory''' are a ripoff: they cost roughly 4 times as much as those sold by the {{NPCSprite|Weaponsmith}}.
